submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "Two Under Two on a CS Timeline"
finding.problem: "My mother-in-law wants another baby now 'before the womb forgets.' But my scar is barely healed and the doctor said wait 18 months. I'm torn between them and my body."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 28-yr-old Nigerian mom pressured (culturally/religiously) for many children; wants 2-yr gap but her scar + 18-month spacing rule clash with family expectations.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (CS spacing + cultural negotiation scripts).". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
